name: Yamato
title: Threaten with Double Attack and slash your opponent's Life!
desc:
Launch a potent offense from the early game using Yamato's [Double Attack] with this aggressive deck.

Gain the upper hand in Character deployment with cards that are stronger when your opponent's Life is depleted.

In the end game, protect yourself with yellow's recovery effects while resting your opponent's Blockers to finish them off.






Card List







x1

cards.name: Yamato
cards.text:
[Double Attack] (This card deals 2 damage.)
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, give up to 2 rested DON!! cards to 1 of your Characters.

cards.name: Kouzuki Momonosuke
cards.text: [Activate: Main] ➀ (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area) You may rest this Character: Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Land of Wano} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: O-Nami
cards.text:
[On Play] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains [Banish] during this turn.
(When this card deals damage, the target card is trashed without activating its Trigger.)
cards.trigger: [Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less.

cards.name: Kouzuki Hiyori
cards.text: [On Play] You may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Add up to 1 card from your hand to the top of your Life cards.

cards.name: Izo
cards.text: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

cards.name: Inuarashi
cards.text: [DON!! x2] [When Attacking] You may trash 1 card from your hand: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, play this card.

cards.name: Kikunojo
cards.text: [On K.O.] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, play this card.

cards.name: Nekomamushi
cards.text: [DON!! x2] This Character can also attack your opponent's active Characters.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, play this card.

cards.name: Gedatsu
cards.text: [On Play] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards.

cards.name: Satori
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Play this card.

cards.name: Kouzuki Momonosuke
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] Add up to 1 of your {Land of Wano} type Characters other than [Kouzuki Momonosuke] to the top or bottom of the owner's Life cards face-up.

cards.name: Denjiro
cards.text: [DON!! x2] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, this Character cannot be K.O.'d by effects.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, play this card.

cards.name: Hody Jones
cards.text:
[Rush] (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)
[On Play] Rest up to a total of 2 of your opponent's Characters or DON!! cards. Then, add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand.

cards.name: El Thor
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if your opponent has 2 or less Life cards, that card gains an additional +2000 power during this battle.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards.

cards.name: Two-Hundred Million Volts Amaru
cards.text: [Main] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this turn. Then, if you have 1 or less Life cards, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 2 cards from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
